Code Data Cases

TL;DRLearn to act where quantization fails.

Quantized agents can get stuck repeating mistakes. Our closed-loop teacher steering uses feedback from failed retries to refine guidance. We distill verified corrections so the agent can act without guidance.

量化之后，
如何找回 Agent 的行动能力

Xiangyu Li2026 / 11 / 07

TL;DR

量化后的 agent 仍能说出合理的计划，却可能在一个参数、一项前置条件上走偏。SteerDistill 关心的是：怎样找到这些决策，用执行反馈修好它们，再让模型在没有指导时也能独立行动。
